name: Appleberry Farm (Atha's Orchard)
description: Appleberry Farm (Atha's Orchard) is a working pumpkin patch in 402 West Main Street, IA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
